Hydrologic_Response_Unit.description: Hydrologic response unit: catchment surface over three unsaturated soil layers and a groundwater cell
Hydrologic_Response_Unit.helptext: A one-dimensional land column: runoff-generating catchment surface, an unsaturated profile discretised into three layers whose thicknesses are in a 1:2:4 ratio (finest at the surface, where moisture gradients are steepest), and a groundwater cell beneath. Runoff leaves through the catchment; lateral groundwater flow and discharge to a fixed head leave through the groundwater cell. Layer thicknesses and all bottom elevations are computed from the ground surface elevation, the depth to groundwater and the groundwater thickness.

area.helptext: Applied to the catchment, all three soil layers and the groundwater cell - every block in the unit shares one plan area.

recharge_K.description: Hydraulic conductivity of the soil-aquifer interface
recharge_K.warningmessage: The interface hydraulic conductivity must be positive!
recharge_K.helptext: Governs recharge from the bottom soil layer into the groundwater cell. Set it equal to K_sat for a homogeneous profile, or lower it to represent a clogging layer or aquitard at the water table.

surface_elevation.helptext: Datum for the whole column. Every bottom elevation below is measured down from here.

depth_to_groundwater.description: Depth from the ground surface to the water table
depth_to_groundwater.warningmessage: The depth to groundwater must be positive!
depth_to_groundwater.helptext: Total thickness of the unsaturated profile. It is split between the three layers in a 1:2:4 ratio, so they are one seventh, two sevenths and four sevenths of this value.

groundwater_thickness.warningmessage: The groundwater thickness must be positive!
groundwater_thickness.helptext: Saturated thickness below the water table. Its bottom elevation is the surface elevation less the depth to groundwater less this thickness.

Evapotranspiration.helptext: Applied to the uppermost soil layer only; the deeper layers and the groundwater cell are not subject to evapotranspiration.

catchment_width.description: Overland flow width of the catchment

manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the surface
manning_coefficient.warningmessage: The Manning coefficient must be positive!

runoff_coefficient.description: Fraction of precipitation that becomes runoff

K_sat.description: Saturated hydraulic conductivity of the soil profile
K_sat.warningmessage: The saturated hydraulic conductivity must be positive!
K_sat.helptext: Shared by all three layers: they discretise one soil profile rather than representing different materials.

alpha_vG.description: van Genuchten ~alpha of the soil profile
alpha_vG.warningmessage: van Genuchten alpha must be positive!

n_vG.description: van Genuchten n of the soil profile
n_vG.warningmessage: van Genuchten n must be greater than 1!

theta_sat.description: Saturated moisture content of the soil profile
theta_sat.warningmessage: The saturated moisture content must be positive!

theta_res.description: Residual moisture content of the soil profile

soil_specific_storage.description: Specific storage of the soil profile

initial_moisture_content.description: Initial moisture content of the soil layers
initial_moisture_content.helptext: Initial condition for all three layers. Each layer's initial storage follows from its own area, thickness and this value.

groundwater_K.description: Hydraulic conductivity of the groundwater cell
groundwater_K.warningmessage: The hydraulic conductivity must be positive!

groundwater_specific_storage.description: Specific storage of the groundwater cell

initial_groundwater_moisture_content.description: Initial moisture content of the groundwater cell
initial_groundwater_moisture_content.helptext: Set this equal to the groundwater porosity for a fully saturated start, which is almost always what you want. The groundwater cell uses a confined formulation, head = cell top + (moisture content - porosity)/specific storage, so at full saturation the head sits at the top of the cell and any deficit becomes an elastic underpressure: with a specific storage of 0.01, a moisture content 0.025 below porosity already puts the head 2.5 m low. The cell's initial storage follows as area times thickness times this value.
